name: TC-CL-02: Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on 22 Wheeler
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingWheelers.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListing [twentyTwoWheeler] [en] — 22 Wheeler TC-CL-02: Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on 22 Wheeler
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CL-02
**Title:** Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on 22 Wheeler
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the 22 Wheeler page, open Check Truck Price, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the 22 Wheeler page
2. Click a truck card's "Check Truck Price" button to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
